d:
Chhath mahaparv ko lekar patna men taiyariyan tej ho gaee hain. digha ghat par chhath vratiyon ki suvidha aur suraksha ke lie prashasan ki or se kya-kya intjam kie gae hain? ghat ki saph-saphaee, suraksha vyavastha, roshni aur any taiyariyon ka jayja liya graund jiro par pahunchkar. dekhie patna ke digha ghat se chhath puja ki taiyariyon ki ye khas graund riport.
'bihar tak' (Bihar Tak) ek aisa manch hai jahan khabron se lekar itihas tak sabkuchh hai. to garv se kaho, ham bihari hain.
